question.text: The empirical formula for a compound with a cubic close packed arrangement of anions and with cations occupying all the octahedral sites in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></msub><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><mo>.</mo></math> The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></math> is (Integer answer)

solution.text:
In AxB
Effective number of B atoms =4 (in CCP)
Effective number of A atoms =4 (all O.V.)
So formula of the compound =A4B4=AB
So x=1
